observations: 2015 Menopause monkey-model study testing high-isoflavone soy across premenopausal and postmenopausal feeding periods.

entities.name: Soy benefit by plaque stage
observations: In ovariectomized monkeys switched from casein-lactalbumin to soy after 34 months, postmenopausal soy reduced iliac atherosclerosis progression and coronary plaque burden only among animals with below-median pretreatment plaques (P=.038, P=.0001); larger baseline plaques were not protected.
Soy fed both before and after ovariectomy reduced coronary atherosclerosis versus control (P=.008), supporting timing and baseline plaque burden dependence in this animal model.
